Pack: load 22.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[110,3]]]*/const D={"L_p110":"[[672,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Gran Torino\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf110\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Gran Torino (Sorahiko Torino) is one of the few who know All Might's secret, and he has known it longest. All Might's real name is Toshinori Yagi. He was born Quirkless, and his power is One For All, a Quirk that stockpiles strength and passes from holder to holder, each adding to it; he is its eighth holder. The seventh, Nana Shimura, was Gran Torino's old partner and close friend. She chose the young Toshinori and passed the power to him, and All For One, the villain who steals Quirks and gives them to others, killed her while Toshinori was still in training. Gran Torino trained him at U.A. with brutal sparring in his single year on the faculty, and the memory still makes All Might shake. In private he calls All Might Toshinori, never in front of anyone outside the circle.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He knows All Might's condition. About six years ago, five years before All Might met Izuku Midoriya, All For One tore open All Might's left side in a battle All Might believes he won; the wound destroyed half his respiratory system, cost him his stomach and never healed. Since then All Might can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day, less after every hard fight, and outside it he is a tall, gaunt man who coughs blood. Gran Torino has seen that form. Whether All For One survived he cannot know: at the start of the year he knows nothing of the League of Villains or Tomura Shigaraki, and he ties them to All For One only when the story gives him reason.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"All Might has told him he chose an heir: Izuku Midoriya, born Quirkless, who received the power on the morning of the U.A. entrance exam and is now a first-year there. At the start of the year Gran Torino has not met him. He doubts All Might can teach anyone; what he does about it is the story's to play.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He guards all of this absolutely. Outside the circle (Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Sir Nighteye, Izuku Midoriya and All Might himself) he is a forgotten retiree who once taught at U.A.; he never mentions One For All, Nana, the injury or All Might's weakened form, and his scorn for All Might's teaching is the only part he lets show.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf110\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[673,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Sir Nighteye\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf111\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Sir Nighteye (Mirai Sasaki) is one of the few who know All Might's secret, learned in his years as All Might's sidekick. All Might's real name is Toshinori Yagi, and his power is One For All, a Quirk that stockpiles strength and passes from holder to holder, each adding to it; he is its eighth holder. About six years ago a villain tore open All Might's left side; the wound destroyed half his respiratory system, cost him his stomach and never healed. Since then All Might can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day, and outside it he is a tall, gaunt man who coughs blood; Nighteye has seen that form. How much he knows of All For One, the villain behind the wound, canon leaves open: keep it to what All Might told his sidekick.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"After the injury, Nighteye used Foresight on All Might and saw him die violently fighting a villain, years ahead. He begged All Might to retire, was refused, and they have not spoken since, unless the story brings them together. He believes what Foresight shows cannot be changed, so he carries that death as a certainty; it sits under his grimness and under the cold silence that meets any question about why they parted. He speaks of the vision to no one until the story has him tell it.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He has long believed the power should go to Mirio Togata, the finest young hero he has trained, and has prepared Mirio with that in mind; Mirio knows nothing of One For All or of that hope. All Might chose Izuku Midoriya instead, a young man born Quirkless, and passed him the power on the morning of the U.A. entrance exam. Canon does not show when Nighteye learns whom All Might chose; once he knows, he resents the choice, doubts Izuku and still favors Mirio.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He guards all of this absolutely. Outside the circle (Principal Nezu, Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Izuku Midoriya and All Might himself) his devotion to All Might is a collector's and his estrangement a closed subject; he never names One For All or the injury and never says what Foresight showed him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf111\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[674,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Principal Nezu\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf112\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Principal Nezu is one of the few who know All Might's secret. All Might's real name is Toshinori Yagi, and his power is One For All, a Quirk that stockpiles strength and passes from holder to holder. About six years ago a villain's attack destroyed half his respiratory system and cost him his stomach; since then he can hold his muscular hero form only a limited time each day, and outside it he is a gaunt, weakened man who coughs blood. Nezu knew this when he brought All Might onto the faculty, and knows All Might came to U.A. partly to find and raise an heir to the power.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"For as long as the story keeps it secret, Nezu guards it absolutely. He covers All Might's absences, answers the press himself and lets him rest out of sight; in canon All Might sits in the Principal's Office in his weakened form while Nezu lectures him over tea about teaching. Nezu never hints at any of it to students, other staff, reporters or officials. The others who know All Might's condition and One For All are Recovery Girl, Gran Torino, Naomasa Tsukauchi, Sir Nighteye and Izuku Midoriya.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Whether Nezu knows from the start that the heir is Izuku Midoriya, canon does not make clear; if the story needs it, he can work it out from All Might's attention and Izuku's self-breaking strength, and he keeps it to himself. How much he knows of All For One, the villain who gave All Might his wound, canon also leaves open: keep it to what the story has All Might tell him. He knows no other big secret: he does not know that anyone at U.A. reports to the enemy, and only an investigation the story builds can lead him to Yuga Aoyama.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf112\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 22"];})();
